title: Where can business development occur in the Flemish part of the NSPD? Decision table (programming stage)

rows.criterion: The GRUP designates an area for seaport- and water-bound companies that must function as the Flemish seaport area of the port of Ghent..

rows.criterion: The GRUP zone is exclusively destined for seaport- and water-bound industrial companies, distribution, logistics and storage companies serving the paper-producing plant..
